tool.name: Savont export
tool.description: Merge Savont results from several samples into QIIME2-compatible files
tool.command: #for $i, $run in enumerate($runs) mkdir -p 'run_$i' && ln -sf '$run.asv_fasta' 'run_$i/final_asvs.fasta' #if $run.feature_table && ln -sf '$run.feature_table' 'run_$i/feature-table.tsv' #end if #if $run.asv_mappings && ln -sf '$run.asv_mappings' 'run_$i/asv_mappings.tsv' #end if && #end for savont export -i #for $i, $run in enumerate($runs) 'run_$i' #end for -o 'export_out' $no_fuzzy #if $relabel --relabel #for $label in $relabel '$label.label' #end for #end if && cp export_out/savont_*.log '$output_log'

repeat.name: runs
repeat.title: Savont run
repeat.help: One entry per sample: the ASV sequences and the feature table of a **Savont ASV** run.

param.name: asv_mappings
param.label: ASV mappings
param.help: Optional ``asv_mappings.tsv`` from **Savont classify** or **Savont SINTAX** on this sample. Supplying mappings enables the merged taxonomy output.

param.name: no_fuzzy
param.label: Keep all ASVs separate
param.help: By default, ASVs that are 10 bp shorter or longer than another ASV but 100% identical to it are merged. Check this box to keep all ASVs separate (not recommended).

repeat.name: relabel
repeat.title: Sample name
repeat.help: Optional replacement for the sample names used in the merged outputs. The number of labels must exactly match the total number of sample columns across all runs (a run that pooled several samples contributes one label per sample). If no labels are given, the sample names embedded in the feature tables are used.

param.name: label
param.label: Sample name
param.help: Name for this sample in the merged feature table and taxon counts.

tool.help:
**Savont export** merges the results of several **Savont ASV** runs (one per sample) into a set of QIIME2-compatible files.
The ASVs of all samples are dereplicated: sequences that are identical, or that are 10 bp shorter or longer but 100% identical to another ASV, are merged into a single feature, so the merged feature table is directly usable in QIIME2. If ASV mappings from **Savont classify** or **Savont SINTAX** are supplied for some samples, the merged taxonomy file contains the taxonomy of each merged feature (samples without mappings are reported as *Unclassified*).
Inputs ------
* **Savont run**: one entry per sample, with the ``final_asvs.fasta`` and ``feature-table.tsv`` outputs of **Savont ASV**, and optionally the ``asv_mappings.tsv`` of **Savont classify** / **Savont SINTAX**. * **Sample names** *(optional)*: replacement names for the samples in the merged outputs. The number of names must exactly match the total number of sample columns across all runs.
Outputs -------
* **Merged feature table**: QIIME2-compatible feature table, one column per sample. * **Merged representative sequences**: one sequence per merged feature. * **Merged ASV taxonomy**: taxonomy per merged feature. * **Merged taxon counts**: human-readable count table per taxon and sample.
